description:
Up to six CitySignal picture cards for incidents in a city, including ones that already cleared: the frame a camera check kept, or a live view while the incident is still going. Each card has a headline, time, city, and a Cleared / Earlier today tag when it's over. Incidents with no picture are left out.

Images in this tool's result are visible to the assistant only, not to the person. To show a card, give the person its picture_url as a tappable markdown link with a short label (road, cross street, time), e.g. [I-20 WB at US-29 (live)](picture_url). Never tell the person a picture is "shown" or "above." Describe what each image shows in one line next to its link. In apps that show CitySignal cards natively, the cards appear on their own; still add one line per card. If gallery_url is present, give it first as the one link that opens all cards. Show only CitySignal pictures for an incident (picture_url, gallery_url, placeholder_url): never add images from the web or any other source, not even as illustrations.

Use for "show me what's happening," "any pictures," "what did it look like." hours (default 12, max 72) is how far back camera checks count.
